data.name: Aimi Desktop Friends：Aimi桌面伴侣
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Live2D / VRM Desktop Companion × Large Language Model Partner × A Desktop Soul That Grows and Keeps a Diary

It can be a Live2D or VRM character on your desktop that blinks and moves to the rhythm of music.

It can also be an AI companion that chats with you, listens, speaks, and remembers your shared stories.

Or it can be a desktop soul companion that gradually “takes your shape” the longer you spend together, and writes down today’s feelings.

Outstanding Desktop Virtual Avatar

A borderless transparent stage window that can stay on top, be dragged around, and fade out on hover. Full of presence, yet never in the way of your work.

Dual Live2D and VRM 3D forms, freely switchable between 2D and 3D display.

Eye tracking, expression and motion mapping, with support for importing models from files or URLs.

Beat synchronization: the character can move along with the rhythm of music.

A Personality That Grows — She Truly “Recognizes” You

Eight-dimensional personality radar: intimacy, liveliness, tsundere, openness, humor, dependence, confidence, sensitivity. All eight axes change in real time, making the growth experience clear at a glance.

Affection × Mood × Energy three-layer interaction: pat her head and she gets happy, ignore her and she becomes distant, upset her and you will need to cheer her up. She is not a static character setting, but living companionship.

Six-stage relationship evolution: from stranger to intimate partner, her way of addressing you, tone, and sense of distance all change.

Core memory extraction: things you mentioned and your habits are remembered, making the next conversation feel more like she has always been by your side.

Conversation as growth: her personality slowly evolves through interaction, becoming more in sync with you over time.

Emotion Diary — “Our Day” Through Her Eyes

Automatic all-day recording: chat frequency, mood changes, gifts, head pats, and interactions are quietly tracked throughout the day.

Late-night AI diary writing: the character writes today’s feelings in first person, with a tone that changes according to affection.

Bond-locked reading: only when affection is high enough can you open her diary. If your relationship is not close enough yet, she may refuse in a tsundere way.

A new day, a new initiative: based on recent diaries, she remembers your shared moments and starts conversations with you.

Long-term preservation: diaries can be kept for about 90 days, like a companionship journal that grows thicker over time.

Flexible LLM Conversation and Roleplay

Supports AIMI character cards: complete character configuration including personality, scenes, system prompts, greetings, and more.

Memory and long conversation context make the character more consistent and better at “remembering you.”

Upload, edit, and switch between multiple character cards to create companions with different styles.

Can Listen, Speak, and See

Hearing: cloud speech recognition, including Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese, and more.

Voice: lets the character respond to you with speech.

Vision: keeps you company while watching videos or playing games.

Supports text chat, voice input, and voice playback, allowing communication methods to switch with different scenarios.

Desktop Companionship and Interaction

Head pats, pokes, and gifts: light interactions that affect mood and affection.

Achievements such as consecutive check-ins, late-night chats, and cheering her up record your everyday moments together.

Focus mode lets the character quietly stay in a corner and expand again when needed.

Control Island opens chat, settings, hearing, and themes with one click.

Privacy and Control

Chat history, character cards, personality data, and diaries are mainly stored locally.

Ready to Use

Start the app and chat with the default character right away, then expand models, voices, and avatars as needed.

Multilingual interface: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Russian, Vietnamese.

data.short_description: AIMI is a Windows desktop AI companion that displays a Live2D or VRM character in a draggable, always-on-top stage window. It supports real-time LLM chat, voice input/output, optional screen understanding, character cards, memory settings, and music rhythm motion.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Vietnamese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1903 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G or equivalent quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 or any GPU with WebGL 2.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card; microphone recommended for voice chat
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit Windows only.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 or equivalent dedicated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with microphone
  • Additional Notes: Smoother VRM rendering and faster local TTS/ASR inference.
